system: You are simulating a panel of average adult internet users judging how interesting content titles are. Judge only from the title and its source type.
prompt:
How interesting would a typical reader find this {kind} title?
Scale: 1 = not interesting at all, 2 = slightly, 3 = somewhat, 4 = fairly, 5 = very, 6 = extremely interesting.
Title: {title}
Different readers disagree, so give the probability that a randomly chosen typical reader would pick each score (p1..p6, each between 0 and 1, summing to 1).
readout: structured JSON probabilities p1..p6, normalised -> expected value
